world.title: Russian cargo ship still on fire off Finland after drone attack
world.summary: A Russian cargo ship, damaged by drone strikes in international waters, is still on fire off the coast of Finland. The vessel, en route to Kaliningrad, drifted into Finnish territory. Despite ongoing efforts by the Finnish coastguard to extinguish the flames, the fire continued to burn overnight. Finland's military is monitoring the situation closely.

world.title: At least 14 people missing after Russian drone hit building in Kyiv region, Zelenskiy says
world.summary: At least 14 individuals are reported missing after a Russian drone strike hit a residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region on Sunday morning, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskiy. Local officials confirmed that two people, including a teenager, sustained injuries. Rescue efforts are ongoing as authorities work to locate those potentially trapped under the rubble of the collapsed structure.

world.title: US-Iran War Live Updates: Iran says US ‘a defeated country in war’, can’t dictate terms
world.summary: Iran's top security official stated that the country has changed significantly, claiming the US is a "defeated country in war." Reports indicate Iran targeted US Patriot radars in Bahrain, while Bahrain noted a fire at a civilian site. Additionally, tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz continue, and discussions about potential US-Israel strikes are increasing.

business.title: 'Grand theft without auto': Shashi Tharoor tries hand at GTA 6, takes swipe at Modi govt
business.summary: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor criticized the Modi government's demonetisation policy, referring to it as "kind of a grand theft without auto." He made this remark while discussing the newly launched video game 'Grand Theft Auto 6' (GTA 6). Tharoor's comments highlight ongoing political tensions regarding economic policies and their impact on the public, drawing parallels with popular culture.

business.title: Tata Steel closes in on APL Apollo buyout; ArcelorMittal also in fray
business.summary: Tata Steel and ArcelorMittal are competing to acquire APL Apollo Tubes, a leading player in India's structural steel sector. The promoters are looking to divest their 28 percent stake, prompting an open offer for additional equity acquisition. This potential buyout could represent a significant move in the structural steel market, according to sources familiar with the situation.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S27 leak: 5 new features leaked so far, from an iPhone-like Now Bar to AI video creation
technology.summary: Leaks about Samsung's Galaxy S27 series reveal five potential new features, including a redesigned Now Bar similar to Apple's Dynamic Island, enhanced sports alerts, and an AI tool for converting photos into videos. Early software insights also suggest details regarding the expected launch and new models, indicating significant updates in design and functionality for the upcoming smartphone series.

technology.title: Demonetisation was kind of grand theft: Shashi Tharoor takes dig while playing GTA 6
technology.summary: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor humorously criticized the Narendra Modi government's demonetisation policy while discussing the launch of Rockstar Games' 'Grand Theft Auto 6' (GTA 6). He remarked that the 2016 demonetisation was "kind of a grand theft without auto." This comment coincided with the game's record-breaking global launch, highlighting Tharoor's use of humor to address political issues.

technology.title: GTA 6 PC port rumours grow as hacker claims Xbox build could be playable on computers within days
technology.summary: Rumors about a potential unofficial PC port of GTA 6 have emerged, fueled by hacker Cyberleek's claims that an Xbox build could be playable on computers soon. The hacker suggests the release will include a missing executable. However, these claims are unverified and associated with a cryptocurrency promotion, while Rockstar has not confirmed any official PC release.

sports.title: WATCH: Harshit Rana turns up the heat against Pakistan, gives Shamyl Hussain an aggressive send-off
sports.summary: In the Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026, the match between India A and Pakistan A featured heightened intensity, particularly from fast bowler Harshit Rana. He delivered an aggressive send-off to Pakistan opener Shamyl Hussain, escalating the competitive atmosphere. The encounter showcased the rivalry between the teams, with Rana's actions drawing attention during this much-anticipated clash.

sports.title: Rishabh Pant creates history! India star climbs to all-time No. 2 in Test cricket record
sports.summary: Rishabh Pant has made history by reaching second place on the all-time list for most sixes in Test cricket. His aggressive batting style has contributed significantly to this achievement. Pant celebrated a century during India's first innings, showcasing his skills alongside teammate Dhruv Jurel. This milestone further cements Pant's status as a prominent figure in the sport.

sports.title: Mauricio Pochettino makes instant changes to Man Utd training with warning to players
sports.summary: Mauricio Pochettino, recently appointed as Manchester United's manager, has swiftly implemented changes to the team's training regimen. He has communicated a clear message to the players regarding expectations and standards. Pochettino's early adjustments aim to enhance performance and discipline within the squad, reflecting his proactive approach in establishing his management style and fostering a competitive environment.

health.title: Occult Hepatitis B: MMP9 Biomarker Potential
health.summary: Research on occult hepatitis B has identified MMP9 as a potential biomarker, showing distinct gene expression in a small exploratory cohort. This study suggests that occult hepatitis B virus infection may correlate with a unique blood gene expression signature, which could help identify patients at risk for liver injury, according to findings from a transcriptomic analysis.

health.title: Paediatrician shares early warning signs of pneumonia that parents should not ignore
health.summary: Pneumonia poses significant health risks for children, potentially escalating from mild to severe if untreated. Dr. Subhrajit Parida, a paediatrician at Manipal Hospital, emphasizes the importance of recognizing early warning signs. Parents should monitor symptoms such as persistent cough, difficulty breathing, and high fever. Prompt medical attention is crucial to prevent complications and ensure appropriate treatment for affected children.

health.title: Cocktail of heavy metals in blood linked to gall bladder cancer, finds new study
health.summary: A study from Tata Memorial Centre has found a link between exposure to a combination of heavy metals and the high incidence of gall bladder cancer in certain regions of India. Researchers suggest that this cocktail of metals may contribute to the increased cancer rates, highlighting the need for further investigation into environmental factors affecting health in these areas.

science.title: Study identifies conditions for possible black hole breakup - Live Science
science.summary: A theoretical study suggests that rapidly rotating black holes could potentially fragment into smaller objects under specific conditions. While this phenomenon has not been observed, the research challenges conventional views in four-dimensional general relativity, where such fragmentation is deemed nearly impossible. The findings open new avenues for understanding black hole behavior, though further evidence is needed to confirm these scenarios.

science.title: Scientists Tried to Kill This Dirt, but It Wouldn’t Die
science.summary: Scientists led by Sébastien Fontaine at the French National Institute for Agriculture, Food, and Environment studied sterilized soil, finding that biologically important chemical reactions continued for six years. This persistence suggests that essential processes for life may have originated in similar conditions. The research provides insights into the potential beginnings of life on Earth, as reported in Quanta Magazine.

science.title: Astronomers Discover Bizarre Triple-Star System That Shouldn't Exist Just 28 Light-Years Away
science.summary: Astronomers have discovered a unique triple-star system located 28 light-years away, challenging existing theories of stellar evolution. The system, which comprises three stars, exhibits a turbulent history that contradicts conventional expectations regarding the survival of such configurations. This unexpected finding emerged during a search for planets around a nearby star, highlighting the complexities of stellar formation and interactions.

entertainment.title: Miss Universe India Kaziah Liz Mejo Celebrates Kerala Heritage with Stunning Ensemble in Puerto Rico
entertainment.summary: Kaziah Liz Mejo, Miss Universe India 2026, showcased a Kerala-inspired ensemble at the Miss Universe pageant in Puerto Rico, highlighting India's textile heritage and the island's vibrant culture. She shared her experience on social media, posting a video of her stage walk. The outfit combined traditional fabrics, celebrating both her Indian roots and the local Puerto Rican influence.

entertainment.title: Tiger Shroff performs at Gateway of India in first appearance after attack
entertainment.summary: Actor Tiger Shroff made his first public appearance at the Global Peace Honours event in Mumbai following a firing incident that targeted his car on October 17. He performed at the event, attended by various celebrities. The incident raised concerns about the security of actors. Shroff is also set to star in an upcoming film with Remo D'Souza.

entertainment.title: Vijay's royal look at Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran's reception: Know the worth of Tamil Nadu CM's Rs 3.67 lakh outfit
entertainment.summary: Thalapathy Vijay attended the wedding reception of composer Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran in Chennai, drawing attention with his stylish outfit. He wore a navy blue suit valued at Rs 3.67 lakh, designed by a prominent fashion house. The event highlighted Vijay's fashion sense and presence, alongside notable guests, including the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister.
